spec.description: The desired behavior of the storage node. Currently changing the spec does not affect the actual storage node in the cluster. Eventually spec in StorageNode will override the spec from StorageCluster so that configuration can be overridden at node level.

cloudStorage.description: Details of storage on the node for cloud environments.

driveConfigs.description: List of cloud drive configs for the storage node.

iops.description: IOPS required from the cloud drive.

options.description: Additional options for the cloud drive.

sizeInGiB.description: Size of cloud drive in GiB.

version.description: Version of the storage driver on the node.

status.description: Most recently observed status of the storage node. The data may not be up to date.

checks.description: Contains list of pre or post flight checks that are performed by the Operator

reason.description: Reason for success or failure of the check

result.description: Result of the check fatal, warning, success

success.description: If true, the check was successful

conditions.description: Contains details for the current condition of this storage node.

lastTransitionTime.description: Time at which the condition changed.

message.description: Message is the human readable message indicating details about the current state of the cluster.

reason.description: Reason is a unique one-word reason about the current state of the cluster.

geography.description: Contains topology information for the storage node.

rack.description: Rack on which the storage node is placed.

region.description: Region in which the storage node is placed.

zone.description: Zone in which the storage node is placed.

kernelVersion.description: Kernel version of the underlying host.

network.description: Contains network information used by the storage node

dataIP.description: IP address used by the storage driver for data traffic.

mgmtIP.description: IP address used by the storage driver for management traffic.

kvdb.description: Indicates whether the node is a kvdb node or not.

storage.description: Indicates whether the node is a storage node or not.

nodeUid.description: Unique ID of the storage node.

operatingSystem.description: Operating system of the underlying host.

phase.description: Phase of the StorageNode is a simple, high-level summary of where the StorageNode is in its lifecycle. The condition array contains more detailed information about the state of the node.

storage.description: Contains details of the status of storage for the node

totalSize.description: Cumulative total size of all storage pools on the node.

usedSize.description: Cumulative used size of all storage pools on the node.
